Socrates tried to bring radical changes in the society. But his attempts in the social field were not accepted and appreciated by the authorities. But convinced of his principles Socrates continued his efforts. The authorities considered him as a threat to their existence and asa result he was arrested and sent to prison. Later, he was given capital punishment because he was frank and outspoken. When he received the news of the death penalty he was not at all shaken. It confused all the officials and even Socrates’ own disciples because they had never seen a person accepting the news of his death penalty with a smiling face. When asked why so, he replied, “I have been preparing for death all my life. 1 have never done anything wrong to any man.
